item.title: Mahou Seijo Himekishi Kanon ~Kukkorose! Shokushu Mamire no Kyonyuu Henshin Bishoujo Senshi~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Rebecca
  • 発売日: 2017-10-27
  • スコア: 4.95/10 (8 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 魔法聖女 姫騎士カノン ～くっ殺せ！ 触手まみれの巨乳変身美少女戦士～
  • 英語名: Mahou Seijo Himekishi Kanon Kukkorose! Shokushu Mamire no Kyonyuu Henshin Bishoujo Senshi

あらすじ

A certain prestigious academy… At late night, in the school building, one beautiful Holy Knight was fighting against a group of tentacles.

She was Izumi Kanon.

During daytime, Kanon was a normal high school girl. But during night, she changed into the figure of a beautiful knight who protected the academy.

item.title: Hitozuma Choukyou Kangoku Gakuen
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Rebecca
  • 発売日: 2016-09-30
  • スコア: 6.3100000000000005/10 (25 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 人妻調教監獄学園
  • 英語名: Hitozuma Choukyou Kangoku Gakuen

あらすじ

The protagonist, Shitara Eiji, is dismissed from his teaching job at a school after attempting to attack one of his students. He suffers severe burns to his face as a result of being attacked with chemicals. He loses his job and teaching license, and makes a living through part-time work. One day, he is called back to the school and is taken to a remote island where he is ordered to teach at a prison school. His mission is not only to teach, but also to train three married women. The story follows the daily life in the prison, where deception, betrayal, and humiliation are commonplace. Will Eiji be able to escape the prison facility?
